title: Your RetroHub arcade, in your pocket.
lead: The games of your RetroHub server, playable offline, with saves that follow you to the web.
alt_home: Home screen: a row of games, the selected game and its activity cards
server_title: A client for the RetroHub server
server_body: The app does not work on its own: it connects to your self-hosted RetroHub server. The library, games, saves and play time come from it.
f1_body: A downloaded game plays without a network. Everything syncs when the connection is back.
f2_body: Start on the phone, continue in the browser, and the other way round.
f3_body: Two versions of the same save? You choose which one to keep.
f4_body: Navigate with a controller, by touch or with a keyboard.
f5_body: A touch layout for each console, movable by hand, hidden as soon as a controller connects.
f6_body: Emulator, rendering, language, region, buttons, turbo and cheat codes.
alt_conflict: Choosing between two versions of a save
cap_conflict: Two versions of a game, side by side
alt_game: Game in progress with touch controls
screens_note: Screenshots show the app in French. More app languages are coming.
install_1: Download the latest version of the APK and install it.
install_2: Enter the address of your RetroHub server.
install_3: Link the phone with the code shown on the web, or with your password.
